The use of minor minerals transported from unauthorized sources and used in works is illegal. If minor minerals produced from unauthorized sources are used in works without a mineral transport permit, the work contractors bills shall not be settled. Only in cases where the contractor executing the work pays to the Department of Mines and Geology a penalty equal to five times the royalty for the minor minerals used in the work, an additional payment AP of 40% of the royalty, and 10% of the royalty towards the District Mineral Foundation Fund, and submits the relevant information, action shall be taken to settle the work bills.

As per the Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules, 1994, the minor minerals used in works shall be compulsorily procured only from authorized minor mineral quarry contractors who have obtained permission from the Department of Mines and Geology, and the minerals shall be used only after obtaining a mineral transport permit. All departments/agencies executing works shall mandatorily comply with this.

itemList.description: Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work (Page No. 8 Item No. 1.14 PWD SR 2023-24 Volume- 1)

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.Mix 1:4:8 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates (Page No. 15 Item No. 2.1.2 PWD SR 2024-25 Volume- 1)

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates (Page No. 16 Item No. 2.4.2 PWD SR 2024-25 Volume- 1)

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. All other type of structures (Page No. 18 Item No. 2.11h PWD SR 2026-27 Volume- 1)

Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.(Page No.7 Item No. 1.9 PWD SR 2023-24 Volume- 1)
